title: vulpia membranacea subsp. longiseta
intro: Vulpia membranacea subsp. longiseta, commonly known as Slender Hair-grass or Long-haired Hair-grass, is a type of plant species in the family Poaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing oxidative stress and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Vulpia membranacea subsp. longiseta include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
